name: Cannon Super Mario Bros. Wii
summary:
A hack made by Leplap and Weland, its made for multi and singleplayer and features
many custom objects, custom music and much more. So are you ready for some fun
cause here we go!

Cannon Super Mario Bros. Wii features:
- 14 full new levels divided over 3 worlds
- Over 50 new goodies and retextured objects
- Many custom music composed over almost all levels
And of course some custom tilesets!
